title: Chapter 843
text:
A few minutes earlier, in the high altitude battlefield of Planet Lighthouse …

The seven Beyond Grade As were embroiled in a chaotic battle. Fire and water collided, psychic energy and magic entangled, machinery and flesh clashed, and psionic energy beams intersected, leaving behind countless burning and twisted energy trails in the air.

It was three against four, and the enemy's attacks had no choice but to slow down. The pressure on Han Xiao was greatly reduced, and with his powerful recovery speed, he gradually stabilized his footing and started to deal with the enemy.

Han Xiao's mechanical army, Austin's Palace of Hidden Spells, Taylor's summoned creatures, Sisko's psychic energy, Dylan's water control, Beyoni's ignite … The battlefield was filled with AOE damage everywhere.

Among them, the strongest AOE damage was the Mech Legion, with over ten million of them. The psionic cannons covered almost every inch of the sky, and [Perfect Mechanical Sense] greatly increased the combat strength of the army. Coupled with the True Damage from [Legendary Battle Technique], Sisko's group of four did not dare lower their guard and maintained their defenses at all times.

Even the Beyond Grade As would not be able to escape unscathed in such an environment, and the mechanical army and summoned creatures that used the human wave tactic suffered even more damage.

The mechanical army could be repaired, and the summoned creatures were endless. Both sides had their advantages.

If it was a one on one battle, Han Xiao would have an eighty percent chance of beating Taylor without [Perfect Mechanical Sense]. Now that he had activated [Perfect Mechanical Sense], it was even more likely that he would win.

However, Taylor had teammates that restrained Han Xiao's Mech Legion, making it easier for him to cast spells and summon endless helpers.

Currently, there were all sorts of summoned creatures on the battlefield. There were Demonic Bats, Azurite Statues, Plasma Hydralisks, Spirit Hunters, Spirit Hermits, and so on. There were all sorts of strange combat styles, and all of them were monsters that had signed contracts with Taylor to nurture. A powerful Summoner would definitely have a variety of summoned creatures.

Han Xiao split out two to three million mechanical soldiers under the command of the combat artificial intelligence to fight these summoned creatures.

The scene of the mechanical army fighting the beast tide was like two armies fighting. The mechanical army cooperated well with each other, and their tactics were precise. They continuously shot down batch after batch of summoned creatures, and their losses were much lower than the summoned creature army.

In the chaotic battlefield, a team of mechanical lifeforms led by Psionic Prime was moving at high speed amidst the crisscrossing cannon fire.

The combat artificial intelligence Sparda did not take over the mechanical lifeforms' bodies and only gave them tactical orders. The specific actions allowed the mechanical lifeforms to display their subjective initiative. This way, the mechanical lifeforms could unleash 100% of their combat strength.

The powerful Data Processing and Battlefield Analysis Modules were running at high power, showing the gaps between the rain of bullets and planning the dodging routes. Psionic Prime's flying posture was agile, and the entire team followed behind him to avoid the energy beams. If they could not avoid them, they would use psionic shields to block them in advance. The speed of the team was very fast.

The direction in which this combat team was heading was precisely the battlefield where the elite summoned creatures were.

The target was a team of very strong Commander Grade Demon Batmen. They were guarding a blue-gold statue that was hundreds of meters tall and continuously shooting laser beams. All of them were buffed by the Summoner's status halo, and their attributes were greatly increased. They had already killed many normal mechanical soldiers and floating turrets.

"Everyone pay attention. Our mission is to eliminate the enemy's elite units."

In the communication network of the mechanical life, Psionic Prime's emotionless mechanical voice sounded.

This team of Demon Batmen noticed the rapidly approaching mechanical life team and immediately turned around to face them.

"The distance is shrinking. Prepare for battle!"

"Target locked. Fire!"

The mechanical lifeforms that belonged to the long-range attack team turned back to their original bodies. There were dark energy turrets, psionic cluster jets, firepower fortresses, and high-energy short-range missile launchers. They fired a series of long-range attacks toward the target.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

These Commander Grade Demon Batmen all activated their red Magic Shields and charged forward while enduring the attacks. From time to time, someone's shield would be broken and penetrated by the long-range attacks of the mechanical life team. There were many casualties.

Facing the attack, the enormous blue-gold statue immediately turned around. White energy gathered in its eyes, and the next moment, thick concentrated Magic Energy beams shot out. The cannon fodder mechanical soldiers and summoned creatures in its way were all blown apart. The remaining Magic Energy beams shot toward Psionic Prime's mechanical life team.

"Giant King Kong, attack!"

Behind Psionic Prime, an enormous shadow loomed over. Countless mechanical components combined and turned into a hundred-meter-tall mechanical life named Giant King Kong.

He raised an enormous psionic shield to protect all his team members and forcefully blocked the Magic Energy beams.

Bang!

The light expanded and caused a rumbling explosion. He only suffered some damage to his outer armor.

The thrusters on the back of the Giant Titan were pushed to the maximum power output. Its huge body leaped into the air and knocked away the summoned creatures that came to stop it. It crossed a large distance on the battlefield and landed on the Azurite statue. The two giant beasts collided with each other!

Boom!

It was as if the earth was shaking!

The blue-gold statue was pinned down by Giant King Kong and given a good beating. Blue fragments fell like rain. While the two enormous creatures were fighting, the small teams below were also engaged in an intense battle.

These mechanical lifeforms were basically all elite units that had grown for a period of time. Among them, there was no lack of individuals that were minibosses. As the vanguard team, their combat power was extremely outstanding. They were the strongest small elite combat team under Han Xiao.

The armed Steel Cavalry, Oathkeepers, beast-type soldiers, and other types of mechanical lifeforms charged forward and engaged in close combat with these elite Demon Batmen. It was a complete one-sided slaughter. The Commander Grade Demon Batmen were sliced into pieces by the various advanced close combat mechanical weapons.

The enemy's Spirit Form Hunters that could flash joined the battle and were captured by the mechanical lifeforms' restraining devices.

Psionic Prime continued to split and reassemble. His dazzling attacks easily cut the Demonic Batman Captain into a pile of minced meat. After reassembling, he turned around and looked around. His teammates had basically finished their battle and wiped out an elite summoned creature squad.

"Humph, easy." Silver Flash let go of the corpse of an elite Demon Batman and let it fall to the ground. "Unfortunately, this is a planetary defense battle. If it was an attack, I could have fired at full power, and the battle would have ended long ago."

"Bullsh * t! Bullsh * t! "Crimson Flame rolled in the air.

Silver Flash ignored him and turned to look at the battlefield of the seven Beyond Grade As in the distance. "Unfortunately, we're not strong enough. I really hope we can get closer to the battlefield and help father."

Hearing this, Giant King Kong threw away the blue-gold statue that was shattered and replied, "Father is protecting us."

"We're clearly weapons made by father, but he's protecting us. Is this the fatherly love that those creatures were talking about?" Silver Flash was curious.

Just as Psionic Prime was about to speak, a piercing sound came from the sky and attracted the attention of many people.

Xiu!

Many mechanical lives looked up.

In the sky far away, a giant dragon spun and fell from outer space, leaving behind a large amount of dragon blood. It was burning with flames all over its body, smashing a large number of mechanical soldiers and summoned creatures far away like a meteor. It instantly passed through the height of the battlefield and smashed toward the ground, shrinking into a red dot the size of a rice grain in everyone's eyes.

Boom!

The giant dragon was like a space-based kinetic weapon that hit the ground, creating a huge shockwave and causing a large number of buildings to collapse!

…

"The one who fell was Milizaus? He's heavily injured? "

Han Xiao, Beyoni, and Austin saw this scene and were shocked.

That shouldn't be. Milizaus was strong enough to stall Sagman and Ninjia. How could he be heavily injured and defeated so quickly?

The three of them were bewildered as they dove toward Milizaus' position in unison, dragging the battlefield to the ground. Psyker and the other three followed closely behind. The distance from the sky to the ground was only a matter of the blink of an eye for them.

The next moment, Han Xiao and Beyoni landed beside the huge crater. Austin controlled the Palace of Hidden Spells to float in midair. Seeing Milizaus' current state, the three of them were shocked.

Milizaus' enormous dragon body was in a terrible state. There was a huge hole in his chest, and the broken bones and organs could be seen. Dragon blood was gushing out, and broken dragon scales were hanging on the edge of the wound.

This terrifying wound seemed to be caused by an attack. Beyoni was shocked. It was hard to imagine what kind of terrifying attack could cause such a wound to Milizaus' tough body.

That was not all. New cracks kept appearing on Milizaus' body. It was as if some kind of energy was causing continuous damage to his body and destroying his cells.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's mechanical suit popped out a needle again and injected a dose of Aurora Life Potion into Milizaus' body. However, it only slowed down the speed of the injury and did not show any signs of recovery.

As the needle was injected into the wound, the combat notification was triggered. Han Xiao looked at the interface, and his heart skipped a beat.

The interface showed Milizaus' current state. His health was only left with 63%, and it was still decreasing. There were many negative statuses on his status bar, and two of them were the most terrifying.

[Cell Activity Suppression – High]: The effect of all healing methods will be reduced by 70%. Duration: Unknown. From Ninjia.

[Double Corrosion]: Receive 12,582 Physical Damage and 15,733 Mental Damage per second. Duration: Unknown. From Ninjia.

"Ugh …" Milizaus groaned, looked up at Han Xiao and the others, and said weakly, "Be careful, they brought the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter with them …"

Before he finished, Sagman and Ninjia landed, and the six Beyond Grade As of the enemy gathered!

Han Xiao and the others looked up and saw the weapon that injured Milizaus. It was the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter floating beside Sagman.

It's actually this famous Universal Treasure … Han Xiao's face darkened.

The Arcane Church is really going all out this time!

"They've even taken something like that out?" Austin's expression suddenly changed, and he immediately wanted to retreat.

He had fulfilled his promise to help and felt that he had already done his best. He did not want to die for this. Relying on the defense and mobility of the Palace of Hidden Spells, he had the confidence to participate in this battle where there was a huge disparity in combat strength. However, the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter's attacks had a strange nature. It could ignore most physical and energy shields. Basically, one could only dodge and not block. This meant that the Palace of Hidden Spells could not help him block the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter's attacks.

Austin's thoughts were clear. The Arcane Church's target was Black Star and the dynasty, not him. If he was determined to retreat, the enemy would not waste their Beyond Grade A combatants chasing after him, and he would definitely be able to escape.

He did not want to have a taste of this weapon that could threaten a Beyond Grade A's life.

"This old man wants to run …"

Although he did not know how to read minds, Han Xiao knew what Austin was thinking when he saw the hesitation on his face.

The appearance of the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter was beyond his expectations. If he had known that the enemy had such a trump card, he would not have separated himself from Milizaus.

With a solemn expression, Han Xiao injected a few more needles into Milizaus. Only then did his injuries stop worsening and gradually recover.

Although [High Cell Activity Suppression] weakened the effect of the Aurora Life Potion, Han Xiao had a large stock of potions. It would be the same even if he injected a few more times. It would just take longer for him to recover.

However, the enemy had six Beyond Grade As. They would not give them too much time.

Whoosh!

The six of them surrounded Han Xiao, Milizaus, and Beyoni in midair. The pressure they gave off was comparable to the sky falling. As for Austin, he was isolated by them.

"Don't interfere. This is your last warning." Sisko looked at Austin.

"…"

Austin glanced at Han Xiao, pursed his lips, and did not dare make a move.

The Ten Thousand Deity Scepter floated in front of Sagman, tilted downward, and aimed at Milizaus, who could not move.

A look of despair appeared in Milizaus' eyes. He was very clear about his own situation. Although he did not know what kind of miraculous medicine Han Xiao had used to heal his injuries, he would most likely enter a state of near death if he was hit one more time, and he would be at the mercy of his enemies.

Just as Sagman was about to activate the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, Han Xiao suddenly took a deep breath and said loudly,

"Don't you guys want the Evolution Cube?"

Sagman's actions paused, and he narrowed his eyes. He did not activate the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter immediately.

"You want to hand it over in exchange for a chance to live?"

"That's right." Han Xiao took a deep breath, took out the Evolution Cube, and secretly removed the sealing effect of the Spacetime Amber.

The six of them focused on the small silver cube in Han Xiao's hand.

Sisko's expression changed. At this moment, he regained his psychic senses toward the Evolution Cube. His eyes sparkled, and he said with certainty, "This is the real deal."

Sagman nodded, looked at Han Xiao, and changed the topic.

"However, do you have the right to negotiate now? If we kill you, we can still get the Evolution Cube. Why should we agree to your request? Whether we capture you guys or kill you, the decision is in our hands. Do you think you have the right to choose? "

"No, you're wrong." Han Xiao's five fingers tightened slightly, and he said with a deep voice, "If I destroy the portable shell of the Evolution Cube here and release its huge body … Hehe, can you guys take this thing away before the dynasty's reinforcements arrive?"

Sagman narrowed his eyes, not surprised at all.

Before the operation, the Arcane Church had already guessed that Black Star would very likely destroy the portable device of the Evolution Cube when he was at the end of his rope. Thus, they had already prepared for this.

EsGod's bargaining chip with them was the information of the Evolutionary Civilization. He had asked the Arcane Church to create a special device to transport the Evolution Cube, and it was currently in the fleet. However, EsGod had left something behind. As long as the transaction was completed, he would provide the information of the portable version of the Evolution Cube.

Therefore, if Black Star was willing to hand over the portable version of the Evolution Cube, it would save them a lot of trouble.

"Alright, as long as you surrender and hand over the Evolution Cube, we can spare your lives. The upper echelons will be happy to see the dynasty pay a price in exchange for you captives."

Sagman agreed to this request, and the lives of the three of them were in his hands. His face was calm and indifferent.

He was the representative of the six of them and could make decisions on the spot. Captives were better than death. Although both would anger the dynasty, the former would have more bargaining chips to deal with the dynasty.

Although Milizaus was annoyed at the crisis brought by Han Xiao, seeing Han Xiao hand over the Evolution Cube and beg for their lives, he could not help but feel sad.

This time, he suddenly realized that Han Xiao had quietly stepped on him. He knew that Han Xiao had a plan, so he used magic to connect the consciousness of the three of them and started communicating.

Han Xiao did not show any abnormalities and seemed to heave a sigh of relief. "As a show of sincerity, I'll tell you the password to activate the portable mode of the Evolution Cube."

Then, he did not care about Sagman's reaction and directly entered the activation program.

According to the information provided by EsGod, activating the Evolution Cube did require a special method. Han Xiao's words were not a problem, and verifying it on the spot might prevent EsGod's information from deceiving them.

"Hmm? When you become a captive, we'll have plenty of time to demonstrate … "Sagman didn't notice the problem at first, but the next moment, he suddenly realized something, and his expression changed as he shouted sternly," Don't worry, we'll have more than enough time to demonstrate.

"No! Stop right there! "

Han Xiao ignored him and completed the activation program.

Hu!

The next moment, he activated the Evolution Energy inside, and it surged toward the six of them in midair.

The six of them hurriedly released their shields. If they were hit by the Evolution Energy, they would turn into a black cocoon and enter the evolution process. Although they could forcefully stop the evolution process and regain their mobility, they would also be controlled for a certain period of time.

Sagman's killing intent toward Han Xiao instantly reached its peak.

We gave you a chance to live, but you did not cherish it and even tried to scheme against us. You're seeking death!

"You're seeking death!"

Without saying anything, Sagman directly used the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter and shot it toward Milizaus. He would cut off his wings first, and there would be time to slowly torture Black Star afterward!

Hum hum hum!

The Ten Thousand Deity Scepter floating in the air vibrated again and suddenly launched an attack. The God Phantoms gathered into an energy pillar and blasted out!

Milizaus thought about what Han Xiao had just said and could only choose to believe him. He ignored the attack of the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter and released offensive spells to attack Sagman and the other five at the same time.

Beyoni also did the same and launched attacks to pin down the six of them.

The surrounding mechanical troops also received the order to fire at the same time!

On the other side, Han Xiao opened his arms and released mechanical balls one after another. They floated in the path of the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter's energy pillar, forming two layers of barriers. Because they were all spherical, the gaps in the first layer were filled up with the second layer.

Then, these mechanical balls rapidly underwent nano-transformation and retracted their shells, revealing translucent amber balls inside.

After staying on Planet Lighthouse for more than half a month, Han Xiao had already used the Spacetime Amber to create a large number of amber balls!

The six people from the Arcane Church retreated to avoid the evolution energy. While dispersing the attacks of Han Xiao and the other two, they paid attention to the results of this attack.

Seeing this, a mocking smile appeared on Sagman's face.

"Shields? In front of the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, shields are useless … What? "

Before he could finish his sentence, the next scene made all six of them widen their eyes in shock!

The energy pillar shot out by the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter did not penetrate the translucent spherical "shield" as they had expected. Instead, it slid across the barrier and shot in all directions. Like a water pillar hitting a lotus leaf, it did not penetrate the barrier at all.

Milizaus and Beyoni also widened their eyes in disbelief. Earlier, when Han Xiao said that he could block the attack of the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, they could only believe it. Now that he had really succeeded, the two of them could not help but be stunned.

The reason why Han Xiao was so certain was not because he blindly believed in the effects of the Spacetime Amber but because in the later version of the World Tree Civilization war in his previous life, the Arcane Church had used the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter before and was defeated by the Spacetime Amber!

Boom!

Just as both sides were stunned, Han Xiao, who knew that the Spacetime Amber could block the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter, took this short opportunity and made the amber ball barrier spread out in all directions toward the enemy, turning into a moving shield.

Sagman and the other five had already recovered from their shock. They hurriedly used long-range attacks to try and get the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter back.

However, the amber balls that spread out in midair moved to the front of these long-range attacks with the help of the micro-thrusters, blocking all the psychic, magic, and light energy attacks of the enemy and causing them to deviate from their target!

The six of them did not expect this translucent spherical 'shield' to be able to block all their energy attacks without being damaged at all. They were shocked.

"What kind of strange thing is this? It can block all attacks? "

By the time they realized that although physical attacks were ineffective, they could use kinetic energy to knock these amber balls away, it was already too late!

Han Xiao used Void Hyperdrive and moved some distance away before he was interrupted. He then grabbed the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter and charged into the sky!

With the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter snatched away, Sagman and the other five abandoned the others without hesitation and chased after Han Xiao, swearing to take back the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter.

The six of them used all their means, and Han Xiao only managed to escape for less than a minute before the six of them caught up.

The combined attacks of six Beyond Grade As were not something he could block at all. He was blasted away without any room to retaliate.

His health instantly plummeted. Han Xiao gritted his teeth and threw away the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter in his hands.

Seeing this, Sagman immediately used his light energy tentacles to grab the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter and snatched it back.

However, before he could even heave a sigh of relief, he suddenly realized that the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter had been sealed in a translucent spherical substance.

No energy could penetrate it! It was exactly the same substance as the spherical 'shield' that blocked the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter!

Sagman's expression changed drastically!

"You … what did you do?"
